## 🔍 Issue Type
**What kind of documentation improvement:**
- [ ] **Missing Information** - Important details are not documented
- [ ] **Outdated Content** - Information is no longer accurate
- [ ] **Confusing Language** - Existing content is unclear or ambiguous
- [ ] **Missing Examples** - Need code examples or practical demonstrations
- [ ] **Broken Links** - Links are not working or lead to wrong content
- [ ] **Formatting Issues** - Poor formatting, layout, or structure
- [ ] **Accessibility** - Documentation is not accessible to beginners
- [ ] **Translation** - Need content in different languages
- [ ] **Completeness** - Coverage gaps in documentation
